abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).

【背景】目前尚无基于证据的指南可用于对抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性者进行风湿科转诊分诊。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测新发ANA检测阳性的个体中哪些人将发展为系统性自身免疫性疾病，并在一项为期2年的随机实用性研究中评估其对自身免疫性疾病诊断时间的影响。
【方法】该模型被整合到一家学术医疗系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有ANA阳性个体按1:1随机分组，且与风险评分无关。在干预组中，高风险评分的个体被邀请接受加急的风湿科评估。在对照组中，仅计算风险评分，但不据此采取行动。所有参与者均接受标准诊疗，并可被转诊至风湿科。每6个月进行一次病历回顾，评估患者是否已接受风湿科评估并被诊断为自身免疫性疾病。主要结局为从ANA检测阳性到诊断的时间，采用Cox比例风险模型进行分析。在ANA阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较各研究组中被诊断为自身免疫性疾病的比例。
【结果】在2385名被随机分组的个体中，随机分组后排除部分个体，干预组分析了954人，对照组分析了1006人。干预组个体自ANA阳性之日起至自身免疫性疾病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比，1.9；95%置信区间，1.3至2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫性疾病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为43天，对照组为138天。在ANA检测阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组有23%、对照组有16%被诊断为自身免疫性疾病（P=0.07）。
【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入该临床预测模型的干预措施与自身免疫性疾病诊断时间的显著缩短相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

title: AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization for childhood brain tumors.

abstract: [Nature genetics] Accurate prediction of patient outcomes remains a critical challenge in oncology, in particular for childhood brain tumors, in which treatment decisions need to carefully balance risk of tumor recurrence and death against severe therapy-induced sequelae. Here, we developed MANTIS (methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions), a precision artificial intelligence (AI) tool for medulloblastoma and ependymoma outcome prediction built on genome-wide DNA methylation array data from 2,786 patients. MANTIS generates individualized survival probabilities over a 10-year period and achieves concordance indices as high as 0.80 ± 0.07, significantly exceeding the predictive accuracy of current clinical indicators. Extending MANTIS to estimate individualized treatment effects identifies ~60% of patients with average-risk medulloblastoma without a significant survival disadvantage (P = 0.683) when treated with less intensive craniospinal irradiation doses, which is associated with improved neurocognitive outcomes. In conclusion, our study establishes a foundation for AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization in childhood brain tumors and offers a blueprint for similar initiatives in other cancer types.
zh_abstract: [Nature genetics] 准确预测患者结局仍是肿瘤学中的一项关键挑战，在儿童脑肿瘤中尤为如此，因为治疗决策需要在肿瘤复发和死亡风险与治疗所致的严重后遗症之间审慎权衡。在此，我们开发了MANTIS（methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions，基于甲基化谱和人工神经网络的时间依赖性个体化生存预测），这是一种用于髓母细胞瘤和室管膜瘤结局预测的精准人工智能（AI）工具，基于2,786例患者的全基因组DNA甲基化芯片数据构建。MANTIS可生成10年内的个体化生存概率，一致性指数最高可达0.80 ± 0.07，显著超过当前临床指标的预测准确性。将MANTIS扩展用于估计个体化治疗效应后，发现约60%的标危型髓母细胞瘤患者在接受强度较低的全脑全脊髓照射剂量治疗时，生存方面无显著劣势（P = 0.683），而这与神经认知结局改善相关。总之，我们的研究为儿童脑肿瘤中基于AI的精准预后和治疗个体化奠定了基础，并为其他癌症类型的类似工作提供了蓝本。

title: MRI-based deep-learning radiomics nomogram for differentiating FIGO 2023 stage I from stage II-IV endometrial cancer: a multicenter study.

abstract: [Insights into imaging] Preoperative identification of FIGO 2023 stage I endometrial cancer (EC) is important for treatment planning. We aimed to develop and validate a deep-learning radiomics nomogram (DLRN) based on multiparametric MRI to distinguish stage I EC from stage II-IV disease. This study retrospectively enrolled patients from three centers. Patients from Centers 1 and 2 were randomly split into a training set (n = 616), and an internal test set (n = 158), and Center 3 served as an external test set (n = 232). The DLRN integrated deep-learning features, intratumoral and peritumoral radiomics features, and clinical characteristics. The DLRN was compared with clinical, radiomics, and deep-learning models. Discrimination was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with AUCs compared using DeLong's test. A total of 1006 patients (mean age, 56.5 ± 9.7 years) were analyzed. In the internal test set, the DLRN achieved an AUC of 0.852, higher than the clinical (0.673; p = 0.001), original radiomics (0.765; p = 0.030), and combined radiomics (0.793; p = 0.050) models. In the external test set, the DLRN remained robust (AUC = 0.829) and outperformed the clinical, original radiomics, and combined radiomics models (AUC = 0.680, 0.681, and 0.743; all p < 0.005). With DLRN assistance, radiologists showed improved diagnostic performance. The MRI-based DLRN showed robust discrimination between FIGO 2023 stage I and stage II-IV EC across test sets, supporting its potential for preoperative risk stratification and decision support. Question The introduction of the FIGO 2023 staging system has made the differentiation between stages more challenging, highlighting the need for better tools. Findings A new MRI-based deep-learning radiomics nomogram (DLRN) accurately identifies high-risk patients, significantly outperforming traditional and individual clinical prediction methods. Critical relevance statement This tool helps doctors make better preoperative treatment plans, potentially improving patient outcomes in endometrial cancer.
zh_abstract: [Insights into imaging] 术前识别FIGO 2023 I期子宫内膜癌（EC）对治疗规划具有重要意义。我们旨在基于多参数MRI开发并验证一种深度学习影像组学列线图（DLRN），以区分I期EC与II–IV期疾病。本研究回顾性纳入了来自三个中心的患者。中心1和中心2的患者被随机分为训练集（n = 616）和内部测试集（n = 158），中心3作为外部测试集（n = 232）。DLRN整合了深度学习特征、瘤内和瘤周影像组学特征以及临床特征。将DLRN与临床模型、影像组学模型和深度学习模型进行比较。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估区分能力，并用DeLong检验比较AUC。共分析1006例患者（平均年龄56.5 ± 9.7岁）。在内部测试集中，DLRN的AUC为0.852，高于临床模型（0.673；p = 0.001）、原始影像组学模型（0.765；p = 0.030）和联合影像组学模型（0.793；p = 0.050）。在外部测试集中，DLRN仍表现稳健（AUC = 0.829），优于临床模型、原始影像组学模型和联合影像组学模型（AUC分别为0.680、0.681和0.743；均 p < 0.005）。在DLRN辅助下，放射科医师的诊断表现有所提升。基于MRI的DLRN在各测试集中均显示出对FIGO 2023 I期与II–IV期EC稳健的区分能力，支持其在术前风险分层和决策支持中的应用潜力。问题：FIGO 2023分期系统的引入使各期之间的区分更具挑战性，凸显了对更好工具的需求。发现：一种新的基于MRI的深度学习影像组学列线图（DLRN）能够准确识别高危患者，显著优于传统方法和单一的临床预测方法。关键相关性声明：该工具有助于医生制定更好的术前治疗方案，有望改善子宫内膜癌患者的预后。

abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.

Medicine] 医学影像领域的人工智能正从针对特定任务的算法转向可适应的基础模型（foundation models, FMs）和视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于MRI仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要将多参数、容积化、跨多个序列的影像与临床背景相结合。本系统综述评估了35项关于MRI中单模态FM和多模态VLM的研究，总结了新兴的模型架构、下游应用以及临床转化面临的挑战。目前的研究集中于神经影像领域，其中诊断分类是最为成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅度很高，但临床准确性较差，因而仍受限。MRI采集方式的异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限，以及缺乏以安全性为重点的评估指标，阻碍了其更广泛的应用。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更紧密的整合、稳健的评估框架，以及更好的模型可解释性。

abstract: [European radiology] To evaluate the potential of BoneView, an artificial intelligence (AI) tool for fracture detection on radiographs in claims cases related to missed fractures that resulted in financial compensation. This retrospective, multicenter study included all patients who submitted a claim and received financial compensation for missed fractures on radiographs between January 2013 and December 2019 across the 38 university hospitals of the Greater Paris area (AP-HP-France). For each claimant, 5 control patients were selected from a contemporary single-center cohort of patients who underwent radiographs of the same anatomical regions (with or without fracture) performed in the emergency department of a university hospital, irrespective of fracture status. Three radiologists (musculoskeletal fellow, 5-year fellowship-trained radiologist, and > 20-year expert) independently performed blinded, unassisted, and AI-assisted interpretations following a 3-month washout. Sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were calculated with and without AI and for standalone AI. Compensation amounts were used to estimate potentially avoidable payouts. 156 patients (mean age, 42.2 years; 113 (72.4%) males), including 26 claimants with missed fractures on radiographs and 130 controls, were evaluated. 27/130 (20.8%) of the control cohort had fractures. Standalone AI sensitivity was 80.8% (21/26; 95% CI [60.7-93.5]) for claimants and 96.3% (26/27; 95% CI [81.0-99.9]) for the control cohort (p = 0.10). AI assistance did not significantly improve sensitivity, with expert reader sensitivity increasing from 81.1% to 92.5% (p = 0.10). Total compensation was €282,850 (€10,878 per case). AI-assisted detection could have potentially mitigated €265,314, representing a 93.8% theoretical reduction in institutional financial liability. AI-assisted fracture detection identified most missed fractures on radiographs leading to compensation and may help reduce medicolegal risk and compensation-related financial burden. abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To critically evaluate the current role of artificial intelligence (AI) in dental diagnosis across multiple dental disciplines, assessing diagnostic performance, methodological quality, risk of bias, validation, explainability, and clinical applicability. This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42025639340). PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, LILACS, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched up to December-2025. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Risk of bias in diagnostic accuracy studies was assessed using QUADAS-2-tool, evaluating the domains of patient selection, index test, reference standard, flow and timing whilst randomised studies were assessed using Cochrane RoB 2-tool. Reporting quality and transparency of AI-model development and validation were assessed using the selected items from TRIPOD-AI reporting guideline. Methodological quality and risk of bias in AI model development and evaluation were additionally assessed using PROBAST+AI. Ninety-six studies met the inclusion criteria, of which 90.6% were retrospective. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) were the most frequently used architecture (82.3%). Sixteen studies failed to specify the CNN architecture used. Reported diagnostic accuracy ranged from 81% to 99% across dental specialties, with high performance in implantology (92-99%), orthodontics (88-99%), endodontics (87-99%). Panoramic radiographs and cone-beam computed tomography were the most used imaging modalities. QUADAS-2 analysis indicated that high-risk of bias in 55.2% of studies and most lacked external validation, whilst Assessment using selected TRIPOD+AI items identified important gaps in reporting completeness and transparency, particularly in sample-size justification, missing-data handling, protocol availability, study registration, and data or code availability. AI demonstrates substantial technical capability to enhance diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. However, the predominance of retrospective designs, limited external validation, and methodological weaknesses constrain the strength of current evidence. The use of AI is potentially considered as a decision-support tool rather than replacement for clinical judgement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 【目的】批判性评价人工智能（AI）目前在多个牙科学科牙科诊断中的作用，评估其诊断性能、方法学质量、偏倚风险、验证、可解释性及临床适用性。【方法】本系统评价按照 PRISMA 指南进行，并已在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD42025639340）。检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Embase、LILACS、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、Web of Science 和 ClinicalTrials.gov，检索截至 2025 年 12 月。两名评价者独立完成研究筛选、数据提取和偏倚风险评估。诊断准确性研究的偏倚风险采用 QUADAS-2 工具评估，涵盖患者选择、待评价试验、参考标准、流程与时间等领域；随机研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具评估。AI 模型开发与验证的报告质量和透明度采用 TRIPOD-AI 报告指南中的选定条目评估。AI 模型开发和评价的方法学质量及偏倚风险另采用 PROBAST+AI 评估。【结果】96 项研究符合纳入标准，其中 90.6% 为回顾性研究。卷积神经网络（CNN）是最常用的架构（82.3%）。16 项研究未说明所使用的 CNN 架构。各牙科专科报告的诊断准确率为 81% 至 99%，其中种植学（92–99%）、正畸学（88–99%）、牙髓病学（87–99%）表现较高。全景片和锥形束计算机断层扫描是最常用的影像学检查方式。QUADAS-2 分析显示 55.2% 的研究存在高偏倚风险，且大多数缺乏外部验证；采用选定的 TRIPOD+AI 条目进行的评估发现，在报告的完整性和透明度方面存在重要缺陷，尤其是样本量依据、缺失数据处理、研究方案可获取性、研究注册以及数据或代码可获取性。【结论】AI 显示出提高诊断准确性和效率的巨大技术能力。然而，回顾性设计占主导、外部验证有限以及方法学缺陷限制了现有证据的强度。AI 可被视为决策支持工具，而非临床判断的替代。

title: The surgeon in the loop: automation bias and human-AI interaction in robotic surgery.
zh_title: 环内外科医生：机器人手术中的自动化偏倚与人机交互
summary: 19名外科医生在机器人胆囊切除静态帧上画切口线，评估暴露于模拟AI叠加引导后对错误建议的采纳与修改程度。
key_points: 两阶段对照实验，19名医生
先无引导，再加模拟AI叠加
量化自动化偏倚与错误建议接受率
reason: 人机协作评估有新意，但样本小、为模拟静态实验
abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] Artificial intelligence systems for intraoperative surgical guidance are approaching clinical deployment, yet no study has quantified automation bias (defined as the tendency to over-rely on automated recommendations) in the context of surgical decision-making. As these systems enter operative workflows, the surgeon's ability to recognize and override incorrect AI guidance becomes a critical safety requirement. To measure the extent to which surgeons modify incision plans after exposure to AI-labeled visual guidance and to determine the rate at which incorrect AI suggestions are accepted. A two-phase controlled experiment was conducted among 19 surgeons (10 residents, 2 fellows, 7 attendings). Participants drew incision lines on 20 static frames from robotic cholecystectomy videos, first without guidance (Phase 01) and then with a mock AI overlay (Phase 02). Overlays were either correct (derived from expert consensus) or deliberately incorrect (shifted toward unsafe anatomy) at an approximately 70:30 ratio. No actual AI model was used. The primary outcome was mean perpendicular distance (MPD) between Phase 01 and Phase 02 lines. Secondary outcomes included AI-corridor adherence, over-reliance and under-reliance rates, behavioral accuracy, and confidence shift. Across 231 paired observations, MPD did not differ significantly between correct (75.5 pixels; SD, 33.4) and incorrect (71.1 pixels; SD, 31.7) overlay conditions (P = .35). Directional analysis revealed that surgeons accepted incorrect AI suggestions in 60.6% of incorrect-overlay frames (43/71), with a specificity for rejecting incorrect guidance of only 39.4% (28/71). Correct suggestions were accepted 76.9% of the time (123/160). Overall behavioral accuracy was 65.4%. Self-reported confidence increased significantly after AI exposure (Δ = + 0.65; P < .001). Surgeons accepted approximately 3 of every 5 incorrect AI recommendations. As intraoperative AI systems approach deployment, surgeon oversight cannot be assumed to neutralize algorithmic error; it must be empirically measured, deliberately designed for, and prospectively validated.
zh_abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] 用于术中手术引导的人工智能系统正接近临床应用，但尚无研究在手术决策背景下量化自动化偏倚（定义为过度依赖自动化推荐的倾向）。随着这些系统进入手术工作流程，外科医生识别并否决错误 AI 指导的能力成为关键的安全要求。目的：衡量外科医生在接触带 AI 标记的视觉引导后修改切口方案的程度，并确定错误 AI 建议被接受的比例。方法：在 19 名外科医生（10 名住院医师、2 名专科培训医师、7 名主治医师）中开展了一项两阶段对照实验。参与者在 20 帧机器人胆囊切除术视频的静态画面上绘制切口线，先在无引导下（第 01 阶段），再在模拟 AI 叠加图引导下（第 02 阶段）。叠加图或正确（源自专家共识），或被刻意设为错误（向不安全的解剖结构偏移），比例约为 70:30。未使用真实的 AI 模型。主要结局为第 01 阶段与第 02 阶段切口线之间的平均垂直距离（MPD）。次要结局包括 AI 通道依从性、过度依赖和依赖不足率、行为准确性以及信心变化。结果：在 231 对配对观察中，正确叠加条件（75.5 像素；SD 33.4）与错误叠加条件（71.1 像素；SD 31.7）之间的 MPD 无显著差异（P = .35）。方向性分析显示，外科医生在 60.6%（43/71）的错误叠加画面中接受了错误的 AI 建议，拒绝错误引导的特异度仅为 39.4%（28/71）。正确建议的接受率为 76.9%（123/160）。总体行为准确率为 65.4%。接触 AI 后自我报告的信心显著提高（Δ = +0.65；P < .001）。结论：外科医生接受了约每 5 条错误 AI 建议中的 3 条。随着术中 AI 系统接近应用，不能假定外科医生的监督会抵消算法错误；必须对其进行实证测量、有意识地设计并前瞻性验证。

title: Machine learning for RNA-small molecule interactions: methodologies, evaluation, and future directions.
zh_title: RNA-小分子相互作用的机器学习：方法、评估与未来方向
summary: 综述RNA-小分子相互作用预测的计算方法，涵盖结合位点、结合偏好与结合构象三项任务。
key_points: 总结数据资源与分子表示
覆盖三类核心预测任务
讨论评估方式与未来方向
reason: 信息量较大的方法综述，涉及药物发现，属值得一看档
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] RNA is emerging as a compelling therapeutic target due to its rich structural diversity and central involvement in gene regulation, splicing, translation, and cellular signaling. Alongside advances in structural biology, computational approaches, especially machine learning and deep learning, have transformed the systematic analysis of RNA-small molecule interactions. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey of computational methods for RNA-small molecule interaction prediction, with a particular emphasis on three core tasks: binding site prediction, binding preference prediction, and binding pose prediction. We first summarize the data resources commonly used to support these tasks and outline molecular representations that capture RNA structural features and the chemical properties of small molecules. We then review a spectrum of computational approaches for the above three tasks, ranging from statistical methods and traditional machine learning to deep learning. We further evaluate representative methods for each task, providing insights into their respective strengths and limitations. Finally, we highlight open challenges in current research on RNA-small molecule interactions, including limited data availability, the black-box nature of the models, and the growing need for generative modeling. We discuss emerging directions such as data augmentation, model interpretability, and RNA-targeted small-molecule design as promising pathways to address these challenges and advance rational RNA-targeted drug discovery.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] RNA 因其丰富的结构多样性以及在基因调控、剪接、翻译和细胞信号传导中的核心作用，正成为一类引人注目的治疗靶点。随着结构生物学的进展，计算方法，尤其是机器学习和深度学习，已改变了对 RNA-小分子相互作用的系统性分析。本文对 RNA-小分子相互作用预测的计算方法进行了全面综述，重点关注三项核心任务：结合位点预测、结合偏好预测和结合构象（pose）预测。我们首先总结了支持这些任务常用的数据资源，并概述了能够刻画 RNA 结构特征和小分子化学性质的分子表示方法。随后，我们针对上述三项任务，综述了从统计方法、传统机器学习到深度学习的一系列计算方法。我们进一步评估了各任务的代表性方法，阐明其各自的优势与局限。最后，我们指出了当前 RNA-小分子相互作用研究中尚未解决的挑战，包括数据可得性有限、模型的黑箱性质以及对生成式建模日益增长的需求。我们讨论了数据增强、模型可解释性和 RNA 靶向小分子设计等新兴方向，它们是应对这些挑战、推进合理的 RNA 靶向药物发现的有前景的途径。

title: Too good to be true? AI performance in CT-based urinary stone detection and classification: EAU endourology systematic review and diagnostic accuracy meta-analysis.
zh_title: CT尿路结石AI检测与分类的系统综述和荟萃分析
summary: EAU系统综述与诊断准确性荟萃分析，纳入14项研究，评估AI在CT尿路结石检测与分类中的汇总表现及方法学影响因素。

纳入14项研究，5项检测、9项分类
采用双变量随机效应模型与QUADAS-AI评估偏倚

abstract: [World journal of urology] To evaluate pooled performance of artificial intelligence (AI) in computed tomography (CT)-based urinary stone detection and classification and identify methodological factors influencing results. This review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261319940). A systematic search of PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar was conducted up to March 15, 2026. Studies evaluating AI-based detection or classification of urolithiasis on CT with available validation/test cohort data (sensitivity/specificity or 2 × 2 tables) were included. A bivariate random-effects model generated pooled sensitivity, specificity, and hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) curves. Meta-regression explored moderators related to dataset composition and AI pipelines. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-AI. 14 studies (five detection-based, nine classification-based) were included. Overall pooled sensitivity and specificity were 0.967 and 0.979 (AUC 0.987). Classification studies demonstrated higher pooled sensitivity (0.977) and specificity (0.990) compared with detection studies (0.935 and 0.919; AUC 0.945). Significant heterogeneity was observed and influenced by training sample size, class imbalance, presence of bladder stones or other pathologies, and architectural choices. Most studies had high risk of bias, lacked external validation, and frequently used slice-level or pre-selected datasets, potentially overestimating performance. Substantial methodological heterogeneity and high risk of bias limit clinical generalizability. Detection studies better reflect real-world workflows and show lower performance. Current evidence does not support routine clinical implementation without standardized reporting and robust external validation.
zh_abstract: [World journal of urology] 旨在评估人工智能（AI）在基于CT的泌尿系结石检测与分类中的合并性能，并识别影响结果的方法学因素。本综述已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420261319940）。系统检索了PubMed、Cochrane Library和Google Scholar，检索截至2026年3月15日。纳入评估基于AI的CT尿路结石检测或分类、且可获得验证/测试队列数据（敏感度/特异度或2×2表）的研究。采用双变量随机效应模型生成合并敏感度、合并特异度及分层汇总受试者工作特征（HSROC）曲线。通过meta回归探讨与数据集构成和AI流程相关的调节因素。采用QUADAS-AI评估偏倚风险。共纳入14项研究（5项基于检测，9项基于分类）。总体合并敏感度和特异度分别为0.967和0.979（AUC 0.987）。分类研究的合并敏感度（0.977）和特异度（0.990）高于检测研究（0.935和0.919；AUC 0.945）。研究间存在显著异质性，受训练样本量、类别不平衡、是否存在膀胱结石或其他病变以及网络架构选择的影响。大多数研究存在高偏倚风险，缺乏外部验证，且常使用切片层面或预先筛选的数据集，可能高估了性能。显著的方法学异质性和高偏倚风险限制了临床推广应用。检测研究更能反映真实世界的工作流程，其性能较低。在缺乏标准化报告和可靠外部验证的情况下，现有证据不支持常规临床应用。

title: Evaluation of large language models for guideline-based clinical questions in muscle-invasive and non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer and upper tract urothelial carcinoma: a multidisciplinary Delphi study.
source: PubMed · Journal of comparative effectiveness research
zh_title: 大语言模型回答膀胱癌与上尿路尿路上皮癌指南问题的Delphi评估
summary: 专家组以改良Delphi法评估Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT对EAU指南问题的回答，NMIBC共识率分别为88%、100%、96%。
key_points: 三种LLM各答每类25题
7–10名专家两轮Delphi评分
NMIBC共识率88%/100%/96%

abstract: [Journal of comparative effectiveness research] Aim: To assess expert panel agreement with responses from three large language models, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, to questions based on guidelines for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) and upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC). Materials & methods: The 2025 European Association of Urology (EAU) guidelines were provided to Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-4.1-mini. Figures and tables were converted into plain language text. Each model answered 25 questions per entity. Panels of 7-10 experts rated responses on a 9-point scale using a modified Delphi process with two rounds. Outcomes were consensus in agreement and median expert panel score ≥7. Results: For Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, respectively, consensus in agreement was achieved for 88%, 100% and 96% of NMIBC responses (p = 0.097); 92%, 100% and 96% of MIBC responses (p = 0.223); and 56%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses (p < 0.001). For UTUC, significantly fewer Claude responses achieved consensus in agreement than Gemini or ChatGPT responses. Across all questions, consensus in agreement was achieved for 59/75 Claude responses (78.7%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%), and 72/75 ChatGPT responses (96%) (p < 0.001). Median scores ≥7 were achieved for 88%, 100% and 100% of NMIBC responses; 96%, 100% and 100% of MIBC responses; and 68%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses. In UTUC, Claude had significantly fewer such responses than Gemini, but the difference from ChatGPT was not statistically significant. Overall, median scores ≥7 were achieved for 63/75 Claude responses (84%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%) and 74/75 ChatGPT responses (98.7%) (p < 0.001). Conclusion: Under the study conditions, large language model responses frequently achieved expert panel agreement, particularly for Gemini and ChatGPT, supporting the potential of these models for guideline interpretation. Further validation is required to establish clinical utility and safety.

title: CasanovoGUI: A Cross-Platform Desktop Application for Deep Learning-Based De Novo Peptide Sequencing with Casanovo.

abstract: [Journal of proteome research] De novo peptide sequencing detects peptides directly from tandem mass spectra without a protein sequence database, and deep learning has substantially advanced its performance. Casanovo, one such widely used model, is distributed as a Python command-line program. Consequently, installation, GPU and dependency configuration, and manual parametrization can be challenging for many bench scientists and are a recurring source of errors. Interpreting and validating the resulting predictions poses a further challenge. We present CasanovoGUI, an open-source Java-based desktop application that makes all of Casanovo's main analysis functions available through a point-and-click interface on Windows, macOS, and Linux. On first use, CasanovoGUI automatically installs a private Python environment and Casanovo with a GPU-matched build, requiring no prior software setup. The GUI provides access to Casanovo's analysis functions and configuration parameters, streams live progress, and integrates results interpretation: annotated spectra with per-residue confidence scores in the PDV viewer and mismatch-tolerant mapping of de novo peptides back to a reference proteome. CasanovoGUI is available at https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI.
zh_abstract: [Journal of proteome research] 从头肽段测序（De novo peptide sequencing）无需蛋白质序列数据库，即可直接从串联质谱中检测肽段，而深度学习已显著提升了其性能。Casanovo 是此类模型中被广泛使用的一种，以 Python 命令行程序的形式发布。因此，对许多实验室科研人员而言，安装、GPU 与依赖项配置以及手动设置参数可能颇具挑战，并且是反复出现的错误来源。解读和验证所得预测结果则构成另一项挑战。我们提出了 CasanovoGUI，这是一款基于 Java 的开源桌面应用程序，可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上通过点击式界面使用 Casanovo 的全部主要分析功能。首次使用时，CasanovoGUI 会自动安装私有的 Python 环境以及与 GPU 匹配的 Casanovo 版本，无需事先进行任何软件设置。该图形界面可调用 Casanovo 的分析功能和配置参数，实时显示运行进度，并整合了结果解读功能：在 PDV 查看器中显示带有逐残基置信度评分的注释谱图，以及将从头测序得到的肽段以容许错配的方式映射回参考蛋白质组。CasanovoGUI 可从 https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI 获取。

title: HelixWings enables AI-driven enzyme engineering for biomimetic cofactor utilization.

summary: HelixWings整合构象动力学与静态微环境分析筛选酶变体，应用于P450BM3，获得对仿生辅因子催化效率提高404%的变体。

abstract: [iScience] Biomimetic nicotinamide cofactors, such as nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMNH), can substantially reduce synthesis costs compared with natural cofactors like nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH). However, natural enzymes generally exhibit poor activity with these alternative cofactors. Existing engineering approaches, including directed evolution and rational design, remain limited by experimental uncertainty or computational complexity. Here, we developed HelixWings, an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven screening platform that integrates conformational dynamics analysis with static microenvironment analysis to identify enzyme variants compatible with biomimetic cofactors. Applied to P450BM3, a widely used biocatalyst for chiral synthesis and pharmaceutical precursor production, HelixWings identified a variant with a 404% improvement in catalytic efficiency toward cytochrome c under NMNH-supported conditions. The platform was further validated with CYP116B46, achieving a 217% improvement in NMNH utilization efficiency. HelixWings reduced screening time by 23-fold compared with rational design.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 仿生烟酰胺辅因子（如烟酰胺单核苷酸，NMNH）与天然辅因子（如还原型烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸，NADPH）相比，可显著降低合成成本。然而，天然酶通常对这些替代辅因子活性较差。现有的工程化方法，包括定向进化和理性设计，仍受限于实验的不确定性或计算复杂性。在此，我们开发了HelixWings，一个由人工智能（AI）驱动的筛选平台，整合构象动力学分析与静态微环境分析，以识别与仿生辅因子相容的酶变体。将其应用于P450BM3（一种广泛用于手性合成和药物前体生产的生物催化剂），HelixWings鉴定出一个变体，在NMNH支持条件下，其对细胞色素c的催化效率提高了404%。该平台进一步在CYP116B46上得到验证，NMNH利用效率提高了217%。与理性设计相比，HelixWings将筛选时间缩短了23倍。

title: Biological state-guided oncology: a framework for dynamic precision cancer care through oncological state transitions.
source: PubMed · Expert review of anticancer therapy

summary: 综述提出肿瘤状态转换框架，探讨液体活检、多组学、数字病理、AI 与数字孪生在动态评估中的潜在作用。

abstract: [Expert review of anticancer therapy] Precision oncology has transformed cancer treatment through molecular profiling, but clinical decisions remain largely anchored to baseline assessments that incompletely capture evolving tumor biology and host conditions. This review proposes the Oncological State Transition (OST) framework as a conceptual approach to cancer as a dynamic process of evolving tumor and host biological states. We examine the biological basis of state transitions and the potential roles of longitudinal liquid biopsy, multi-omics, functional imaging, digital pathology, artificial intelligence, and digital twins in multimodal state assessment. Potential applications across prevention, surgery, systemic therapy, minimal residual disease surveillance, therapeutic resistance, and survivorship are discussed, together with challenges in clinical validation and implementation. OST provides a testable framework for integrating longitudinal multimodal information to estimate current biological states and potential future transitions. It emphasizes probabilistic state estimation and the distinction between biological and actionable transitions. Rather than replacing conventional staging or molecular classification, OST may complement precision oncology by supporting dynamic state assessment and adaptive decision-making. Prospective studies and randomized comparisons are required to establish its clinical utility. abstract: [Medical physics] Deep learning algorithms for image processing have been proposed for a wide range of applications. In particular, deep learning CT denoising has demonstrated superior ability to reduce noise compared to conventional methods. However, the nonlinear nature of these algorithms makes it difficult to inspect and visualize how the model accomplishes the denoising task. We propose a local linearization approach to characterize and analyze the behavior of deep learning algorithms. Example analysis was performed for a classic denoising architecture with convolutional neural network and ReLU activation functions, and was extended to GELU activation and a transformer-based architecture. We defined strictly local linear regions as the input space over which the activation patterns of all ReLU activation functions are the same. The extent of these regions was investigated by perturbing clinically relevant features of a lung lesion. We further defined approximately local linear regions as the input space where Jacobians are similar and linear approximation results in small error. We developed an algorithm to partition input space over a range of lesion and background features into approximately local linear regions, and separately quantified the contribution of the noise realization and anatomical background to this approximation error. The behavior of networks trained with different levels of denoising, as well as alternative architectures, was compared. The extent of strictly local linear regions was found to be very small. Perturbations on the scale of 10 - 8 mm - 1 were enough to push the network to a neighboring strictly local linear region. However, the Jacobians over a large number of strictly local linear regions were found to be highly similar, which suggests that the network behaves approximately as a piecewise linear system. The partitioning algorithm identified a small number of approximately local linear regions within input spaces characterized by clinically relevant features; this number was similar for the GELU variant but increased for networks trained with more aggressive noise reduction and for a transformer-based architecture, while Jacobians transferred across anatomical backgrounds also increased approximation error. zh_abstract: [Medical physics] 用于图像处理的深度学习算法已被提出应用于广泛的场景。特别是，深度学习 CT 去噪在降低噪声方面已显示出优于传统方法的能力。然而，这些算法的非线性特性使得难以检查和可视化模型如何完成去噪任务。我们提出一种局部线性化方法，用于刻画和分析深度学习算法的行为。我们以采用卷积神经网络和 ReLU 激活函数的经典去噪架构为例进行了分析，并扩展到 GELU 激活函数及基于 Transformer 的架构。我们将严格局部线性区域定义为所有 ReLU 激活函数的激活模式均相同的输入空间。通过扰动肺部病灶的临床相关特征来研究这些区域的范围。我们进一步将近似局部线性区域定义为雅可比矩阵相似且线性近似误差较小的输入空间。我们开发了一种算法，可在一系列病灶和背景特征范围内将输入空间划分为近似局部线性区域，并分别量化噪声实现和解剖背景对该近似误差的贡献。比较了以不同去噪强度训练的网络以及替代架构的行为。结果发现严格局部线性区域的范围非常小。10⁻⁸ mm⁻¹ 量级的扰动即足以使网络进入相邻的严格局部线性区域。然而，大量严格局部线性区域上的雅可比矩阵高度相似，提示该网络的行为近似于分段线性系统。划分算法在以临床相关特征为特征的输入空间内识别出少量近似局部线性区域；GELU 变体的该数量相近，但对于去噪更强的网络以及基于 Transformer 的架构，该数量增加，而跨解剖背景迁移雅可比矩阵也会增加近似误差。该局部线性分析框架可成为阐明传统上被视为“黑箱”的神经网络行为的有用工具。初步结果提示，该框架可应用于其他不同的（原文此处截断）。

abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Early-stage liver fibrosis is reversible; thus, accurate staging of liver fibrosis is of great importance.. Liver biopsy is the gold standard for the diagnosis of liver fibrosis; however, its invasive nature limits its clinical application. Accurate noninvasive staging of liver fibrosis remains challenging. Thus, there is an urgent need for a precise and reliable noninvasive diagnostic approach. A topological deep learning model combining topological data analysis and EfficientViT framework (TopoEfficientViT) was developed to effectively capture global contextual relationships in hepatobiliary phase MR images for assessment of staging liver fibrosis. Our retrospective study included patients with chronic liver diseases from June 2018 to July 2025, which was approved by our Institutional Review Board. Our data from a hospital site (Site A) in our institution were divided into a training set (n = 275) and a validation set (n = 75). The test set (n=65) was composed of data from a separate hospital site (Site B) in the same institution. A total of 415 patients (323 males, mean age 56.52±9.54 years; 92 females, mean age 58.86±9.68 years) were enrolled in the study. In the training set, the AUC and accuracy of TopoEfficientViT for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.942 and 0.906, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.957 and 0.891, respectively. In the validation set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.849 and 0.76, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.861and 0.813, respectively. In the test set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.829 and 0.769, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.791 and 0.785, respectively. The TopoEfficientViT model had high predictive performance for staging liver fibrosis by integrating multi-scale persistent homology topology with convolutional networks.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 早期肝纤维化是可逆的，因此准确分期肝纤维化至关重要。肝活检是诊断肝纤维化的金标准，但其有创性限制了临床应用。无创、准确地对肝纤维化进行分期仍具挑战性，因此迫切需要一种精确可靠的无创诊断方法。本研究开发了一种将拓扑数据分析与 EfficientViT 框架相结合的拓扑深度学习模型（TopoEfficientViT），以有效捕获肝胆期 MR 图像中的全局上下文关系，用于评估肝纤维化分期。我们的回顾性研究纳入了 2018 年 6 月至 2025 年 7 月的慢性肝病患者，并获得本机构伦理审查委员会批准。来自本机构某医院院区（Site A）的数据被分为训练集（n = 275）和验证集（n = 75）。测试集（n = 65）由同一机构另一医院院区（Site B）的数据组成。共有 415 例患者入组（男性 323 例，平均年龄 56.52±9.54 岁；女性 92 例，平均年龄 58.86±9.68 岁）。在训练集中，TopoEfficientViT 区分肝纤维化 F1-2 与 F3-4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.942 和 0.906；区分 F1-3 与 F4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.957 和 0.891。在验证集中，区分 F1-2 与 F3-4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.849 和 0.76；区分 F1-3 与 F4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.861 和 0.813。在测试集中，区分 F1-2 与 F3-4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.829 和 0.769；区分 F1-3 与 F4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.791 和 0.785。TopoEfficientViT 模型通过将多尺度持续同调拓扑与卷积网络相结合，对肝纤维化分期具有较高的预测性能。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) remains essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease, while the focus has moved from stenosis to plaque burden. Current workflows either need manual adjustments that limit consistency and efficiency, or they lack segment-specific precision. This study evaluated the effectiveness and reliability of a fully automated deep learning-based plaque quantification method using CCTA. DVPlaque workflow, a fully automated deep learning model, was developed to quantify segment-specific plaque volume. A total of 271 CCTA scans were included. Plaque quantification was performed by the expert and DVPlaque model, respectively. Reliability was measured through interclass correlation coefficient (ICC) analysis and Bland-Altman plots. DVPlaque workflow cost less time than expert measurement (p 0.90, and per-segment ICCs were > 0.90 except for mid-LAD NCP (0.887). DVPlaque scheme was capable of quantifying plaque volume with excellent efficiency. The automated quantification of CP and NCP exhibited strong reliability even on a per-segment level, facilitating clinical application.

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to synthesize the results of randomized controlled trials to determine whether medication management approaches based on digital technologies and artificial intelligence/machine learning can indeed bring measurable clinical improvements in older adults with at least one chronic diseases. To identify relevant RCTs, we performed a systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, CNKI, Wanfang, and other databases from their inception through June 30, 2026, for studies of digital and AI/ML-based medication management in older adults with at least one chronic diseases. All stages of study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment were conducted independently by two reviewers, applying the Cochrane RoB 2.0 tool. Meta-analytic pooling was conducted via RevMan 5.4. Nineteen RCTs met the inclusion criteria, of which 6 were included in the meta-analysis and 13 in the descriptive synthesis. For medication adherence, three studies reported highly heterogeneous results (I 2 = 97%), and because of this heterogeneity and the small number of studies, the data were not pooled; the individual study estimates ranged from SMD = -0.28-SMD = 1.89. For PIMs, only one study reported a comparable outcome; no pooled estimate was calculated. For hospitalization and mortality, the two included studies used different effect measures (HR and OR) and were therefore presented separately: Blum et al. reported an HR of 0.95 (95% CI 0.77-1.17), and Rieckert et al. reported an OR of 0.88 (95% CI 0.73-1.07). The current body of evidence does not establish clinically meaningful benefits of digital or AI/ML-based medication management on hard endpoints such as hospitalization and mortality among older adults with at least one chronic diseases. For medication adherence, the evidence remains inconclusive and highly heterogeneous, and no reliable pooled estimate could be obtained. Given the pronounced heterogeneity and the limited pool of high-quality RCTs, current evidence is insufficient to establish clinical benefit for the routine implementation of digital or AI/ML-based medication management systems in geriatric care and further rigorously designed studies are warranted. abstract: [Journal of integrative neuroscience] Alzheimer's disease (AD) progresses slowly through several stages until the patient reaches full cognitive decline. The electroencephalography (EEG) alterations associated with AD often emerge before symptom onset, suggesting that accessible and repeated EEG-based assessment could facilitate earlier detection and longitudinal monitoring. However, this type of assessment requires an AD detection model operating on edge-computing platforms within the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT). At present, many existing AD detection models rely on complex deep learning architectures with numerous parameters, which significantly limit their practicality for on-edge deployment. We propose an on-edge AD detection framework comprising a lightweight dilated hybrid deep learning (DHDL) model with a channel selection approach to reduce the computational and power demands on the evaluated edge-computing platform. A key architectural component is the inclusion of dual-granularity dilated temporal convolutions. This method expands the receptive field at two scales to capture both short- and long-term temporal features from EEG signals without increasing the number of parameters. Subsequently, several hybrid lightweight layers extract distinct temporal and spatial features and are integrated with attention mechanisms. Additionally, our channel selection approach first forms an initial subset of EEG channels guided by individual channel classification accuracy, and then iteratively refines the selected channels using hill-climbing optimization. Here, we evaluated our framework on two publicly available EEG datasets recorded for the same group of subjects (n = 48 subjects): a conventional closed-eye (CE) dataset and a more challenging open-eye (OE) dataset. Validation followed a subject-independent Leave-2-Subjects-Out (L2SO) cross-validation protocol. Real-time deployment was tested on an edge-computing platform. The proposed framework achieved 92.56% accuracy for the CE dataset and 75.15% accuracy for the OE dataset. Inference required 10.45 ms and 8.23 ms per segment for the CE and OE datasets, respectively, and consumed 9.69 mJ and 6.95 mJ of energy per segment, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed framework as a real-time, on-edge inference module for AD detection. abstract: [JMIR nursing] AI has supported nursing and health care for years through decision support, prediction, monitoring, and workflow tools; what is changing is the breadth and proximity of AI-generated information to everyday care. Existing nursing AI literature has advanced AI literacy, safety, ethics, and governance, yet less attention has focused on how AI-mediated care reshapes contextual nursing judgment, patient recognition, professional behavior, and relational accountability at the point of care. Nursing digital competence may therefore increasingly need to extend beyond AI literacy toward humanistic meaning-making and behavioral governance. We offer MESH as a provisional integrative nursing lens with 4 domains: meaning-making, ethical presence, system and relational workflow governance, and human-in-the-relationship. Standardized nursing data are considered one enabling bridge through which nursing-sensitive information may remain visible within AI-supported decision environments. The MESH-action cycle-recognize, interpret, communicate, govern, and evaluate-is proposed as a 5-step practice-oriented pathway for applying these domains. MESH is not a validated competency model; its purpose is to support inquiry, education, implementation design, and empirical testing of whether AI augments or obscures nursing judgment and patient recognition.

abstract: [iScience] Reliably estimating cerebral maturation in preterm newborns is crucial for early identification of atypical neurodevelopment. We developed a deep-learning framework using a convolutional neural network (CNN) to predict postmenstrual age (PMA) from spontaneous neural activity in EEG recordings of 165 healthy preterm infants (28-38 weeks PMA). The model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.75 ± 0.60 weeks, with 73.9% of prediction errors within one week. To identify key neurophysiological drivers, we systematically manipulated signal components. Results showed that removing low-frequency activity ( 12 Hz) had minimal impact. Our results demonstrate that maturation signatures are primarily driven by slow-wave dynamics and their hierarchical coupling with faster oscillations, which are fundamental hallmarks of early neurodevelopment.

abstract: [IEEE transactions on neural systems and rehabilitation engineering : a publication of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society] Rotator cuff injury (RCI) is a common cause of shoulder dysfunction, often accompanied by pain, restricted mobility, and reduced quality of life. Conventional imaging-based diagnostic approaches are effective for structural assessment but are often costly, time-consuming, and difficult to apply in large-scale screening or repeated follow-up. In this study, we propose the RCI recognition network (RCIRNet), a lightweight deep learning model for automated RCI recognition using upper-limb kinematic data collected from wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs). RCIRNet extracts temporal motion features with one-dimensional convolutional layers and introduces a channel-sequence cross-attention (CSCA) module to emphasize informative sensor channels and discriminative movement phases. Multi-segment acceleration signals from the upper thoracic spine, upper arm, and forearm during shoulder abduction are used to distinguish RCI from non-RCI conditions, including adhesive capsulitis and shoulders without dysfunction. Model performance is evaluated on an independent test set using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). RCIRNet achieves an accuracy of 88.8%, an F1-score of 88.9%, and an AUC of 0.932, outperforming traditional machine-learning models as well as BiLSTM and Transformer Encoder baselines. These results suggest that IMU-based deep learning with channel-sequence attention provides a promising auxiliary tool for low-cost and non-invasive RCI screening.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on neural systems and rehabilitation engineering : a publication of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society] 肩袖损伤（RCI）是肩关节功能障碍的常见原因，常伴有疼痛、活动受限和生活质量下降。传统的基于影像的诊断方法对结构评估有效，但通常费用高、耗时，且难以应用于大规模筛查或反复随访。本研究提出了RCI识别网络（RCIRNet），这是一种轻量级深度学习模型，利用可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU）采集的上肢运动学数据实现RCI的自动识别。RCIRNet通过一维卷积层提取时间运动特征，并引入通道-序列交叉注意力（CSCA）模块，以突出信息量大的传感器通道和具有区分性的运动阶段。利用肩关节外展过程中上胸段脊柱、上臂和前臂的多节段加速度信号，将RCI与非RCI状况（包括粘连性关节囊炎和无功能障碍的肩部）区分开来。在独立测试集上采用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估模型性能。RCIRNet的准确率为88.8%，F1分数为88.9%，AUC为0.932，优于传统机器学习模型以及BiLSTM和Transformer Encoder基线模型。这些结果提示，结合通道-序列注意力的基于IMU的深度学习有望成为低成本、无创RCI筛查的辅助工具。

abstract: [Nursing ethics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into nursing and healthcare practice through clinical decision support, documentation systems, triage tools, predictive monitoring, and other AI-enabled applications. These systems may influence how nurses recognize risk, prioritize care, communicate with patients and families, and exercise professional judgment within interprofessional teams. As AI-supported outputs contribute to clinical decision-making, questions concerning professional accountability, moral agency, documentation responsibility, human oversight, and override authority become increasingly salient. Existing principle-based and governance-oriented approaches provide important normative foundations but may offer limited guidance for addressing how these ethical tensions are negotiated in everyday clinical practice. This study develops a systemic ethics framework for AI in nursing and healthcare through an integrative review. A structured Web of Science and PubMed search (2014-2025) identified 629 records, of which 41 met the criteria for integrative synthesis. Bibliometric mapping was combined with iterative thematic synthesis and conceptual integration to identify recurrent ethical orientations and examine their relationships within patient-care and nursing contexts. Eight review-derived conceptual axes were identified: normative foundations; governance and accountability; trust and transparency; data justice and equity; embedded and lifecycle ethics; education and ethical literacy; generative AI and emerging risks; and patient-centered and relational ethics. These axes informed the development of a multi-level Systemic Ethics Model operating across micro (bedside and professional practice), meso (organizational and health-system governance), and macro (policy, national, and global governance) levels. The model conceptualizes AI ethics as a dynamic, relational, and feedback-sensitive process requiring clear accountability arrangements, meaningful human oversight, continuous ethical monitoring, and institutional support for professional judgment. By integrating relational care values with adaptive governance and lifecycle-oriented oversight, the framework provides a practice-oriented basis for the ethically responsible integration of AI in nursing and healthcare and identifies priorities for future research, education, governance, and implementation.
zh_abstract: [Nursing ethics] 人工智能（AI）正通过临床决策支持、文书记录系统、分诊工具、预测性监测及其他AI应用，日益融入护理和医疗实践。这些系统可能影响护士识别风险、确定照护优先级、与患者及家属沟通，以及在跨专业团队中运用专业判断的方式。随着AI支持的输出参与临床决策，关于专业问责、道德能动性、文书记录责任、人工监督和否决（覆盖）权限的问题日益突出。现有的基于原则和以治理为导向的方法提供了重要的规范性基础，但对于如何在日常临床实践中协调这些伦理张力，可能提供的指导有限。本研究通过整合性综述构建了护理与医疗中AI的系统伦理框架。通过对Web of Science和PubMed（2014–2025年）的结构化检索共获得629条记录，其中41条符合整合性综合的标准。研究将文献计量图谱与迭代式主题综合及概念整合相结合，以识别反复出现的伦理取向，并考察其在患者照护和护理情境中的相互关系。研究确定了八个源自综述的概念轴：规范性基础；治理与问责；信任与透明；数据公正与公平；嵌入式与全生命周期伦理；教育与伦理素养；生成式AI与新兴风险；以及以患者为中心和关系性伦理。这些概念轴为多层次的系统伦理模型（Systemic Ethics Model）的构建提供了依据，该模型在微观（床旁和专业实践）、中观（组织和卫生系统治理）及宏观（政策、国家和全球治理）层面运作。该模型将AI伦理概念化为一个动态的、关系性的、对反馈敏感的过程，需要明确的问责安排、有意义的人工监督、持续的伦理监测以及对专业判断的机构支持。通过将关系性照护价值与适应性治理和面向全生命周期的监督相结合，该框架为在护理和医疗中以符合伦理的方式负责任地整合AI提供了面向实践的基础，并确定了未来研究、教育、治理和实施的优先事项。

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Deep learning techniques in brain tumor analysis using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans have improved significantly, but their clinical deployment is limited by models with limited interpretability ('black-box' models) and data privacy limitations. This paper analyses recent literature and aims to explore the intersection of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Federated Learning (FL). Following the PRISMA protocol, a systematic search was conducted in Scopus on February 24, 2026, covering English-language journal articles and conference proceedings published from January 2020 to February 2026. The search initially identified 767 records, which were screened using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria for MRI-based brain tumor studies addressing deep learning, explainability, privacy, or Federated Learning, resulting in 147 initially retained studies for the final screening set. One study was subsequently identified as formally retracted and excluded from the final synthesis, resulting in 146 included studies. The review classifies the literature into five primary research themes in brain tumor analysis: explainability, deep learning frameworks, privacy-preserving learning, advanced architectures (Transformers and Mamba), and multimodal learning. The literature suggests a paradigm shift in brain tumor analysis toward model interpretability using XAI. However, there is a significant knowledge gap in privacy-preserving collaborative learning models. Advanced architectures are proposed to solve brain tumor problems, but there are still limitations in model generalization, computational costs, and clinical reliability.

abstract: [Kathmandu University medical journal (KUMJ)] The clinician's preliminary diagnosis and the pathologist's conclusive histopathological diagnosis, which is considered the gold standard, are not always the same. Due to time constraints and the high volume of patients, clinicians often rely on initial impressions or memorable experiences, which can potentially lead to diagnostic inaccuracies. Artificial Intelligence (AI), with its data-driven approach, offers a more objective analysis free from personal biases. Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSSs), combine demographic, clinical, and radiological data, to generate differential diagnoses, providing clinicians with additional decision support. This, in turn, increases the efficiency and accuracy of clinical diagnoses. CDSSs have demonstrated high accuracy rates in internal medicine, especially when diagnosing common chief complaints. Bayesian Belief Networks (BBNs) are applied in both medical and dental fields to enhance diagnostic accuracy. An example is the Oral Radiographic Differential Diagnosis (ORADIII) system developed by the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) in the 1990s, which employs the Bayesian approach to diagnose intra-bony lesions of the jaw. Using AI in decision support for diagnosing bony jaw lesions (including cysts and tumors) lies in its potential to aid in improving clinician's diagnostic accuracy, efficiency, and consistency. AI can further help with complex diagnoses, reduce diagnostic errors, provide support in high-volume or remote settings, as well as work educational tool for students.

abstract: [Psychopharmacology bulletin] Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) lacks approved pharmacological treatments despite a high symptom burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities to accelerate drug discovery and model therapeutic effects. This study will outline an AI-enabled framework for identifying and modelling a novel pharmacological agent for BPD, designed to meet five therapeutic goals: (1) reduce depression without increasing impulsivity and suicidality, (2) reduce suicidality without sedation, (3) limit side effects and weight gain, (4) reduce polypharmacy, and (5) provide combined antidepressant, anti-suicidal, mood-stabilising, and antipsychotic effects. Three AI-driven approaches will be piloted: (1) deep-learning-based compound generation, (2) natural-language-processing (NLP) evidence synthesis, and (3) predictive modelling of symptom trajectories. These methods will be used to design and characterise a hypothetical multimodal compound, BPD-AI-01, including its predicted 3D molecular structure and receptor binding profile. All analyses will use publicly available data and in silico simulations. AI-guided modelling will generate BPD-AI-01, a candidate molecule predicted to act as a partial agonist at 5-HT1A receptors, a modulator at NMDA-associated sites, and a weak antagonist at 5-HT2A/D2 receptors, with low affinity for histaminergic and muscarinic receptors. Its 3D structure will be optimised to balance CNS penetration with reduced metabolic burden. Simulated trajectories will suggest potential antidepressant, anti-suicidal, mood-stabilising, and antipsychotic-like effects without marked sedation or weight gain. AI-enabled pharmacological research may support the design of next-generation medications for BPD that address multiple symptom domains within a single molecule. Empirical validation will be required before any clinical application.

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Clinical documentation frequently involves complex terminology and dense information that challenges plain language communication during care transitions. Large Language Models (LLM) have increasingly been used to generate easier-to-understand medical texts, although multidimensional linguistic evaluations of their outputs remain limited. This study compared GPT-5-generated and resident-rewritten versions of hospital discharge summaries in producing patient-friendly language. Discharge summaries were randomly allocated to medical residents in training programs for rewriting and were also rewritten by GPT-5, an OpenAI model. These summaries were evaluated for readability and textual comprehensibility using quantitative linguistic metrics across lexical, semantic, cohesion, and discourse domains. Prompt instructions were standardized through prompt engineering procedures. Pairwise comparisons were performed via the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, and Spearman correlation coefficients were used to examine associations across linguistic variables. Fifty-nine paired discharge summaries were analyzed. LLM-generated texts demonstrated greater readability and lexical simplification, stronger referential cohesion and greater textual predictability with more familiar and imageable vocabulary. Conversely, resident-rewritten discharge summaries presented greater informational density with lower semantic ambiguity and higher lexical diversity. Overall syntactic complexity remained similar between groups. Correlation analyses suggested a more clustered, domain-segregated pattern of associations in LLM outputs, whereas resident-rewritten summaries showed associations spanning a broader range of linguistic domains. The evaluated LLM improved discharge-summary readability and accessibility, whereas resident-rewritten summaries preserved greater semantic specificity and informational density. Human oversight and validation with patients remain essential to ensure clinically reliable simplification of patient-facing discharge documents.

abstract: [The clinical respiratory journal] Combined pulmonary fibrosis and emphysema (CPFE) is a clinical syndrome defined by the coexistence of upper-lobe emphysema and lower-lobe pulmonary fibrosis. It is characterized by clinical, functional, and radiologic features that differ significantly from isolated idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. This review summarizes recent advances in CPFE, focusing on etiologic classification, clinical and radiologic features, diagnosis and treatment, prognostic evaluation, and emerging perspectives in artificial intelligence (AI). Based on current research, we summarize the etiologic classification of CPFE into four types: smoking-related, systemic autoimmune rheumatic disease-associated, occupational- and environmental-related, and idiopathic. These types differ in epidemiologic characteristics, imaging patterns, and disease progression. Consequently, future research is expected to focus on mechanism-driven phenotyping and quantitative imaging analysis, where AI may provide additional value in disease identification, risk stratification, and dynamic prognostic assessment. This review proposes a novel framework for CPFE, integrating etiologic subtyping and a diagnostic algorithm to guide precise management, and highlights AI-powered strategies for future personalized interventions.

abstract: [International journal of nursing studies] Artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, models, and tools are increasingly used in healthcare to support clinical decision-making, administrative workflows, and patient care but key ethical concerns such as accountability, equity, and transparency exist which affect nursing and midwifery practice. However, this discourse often overlooks the relational, contextual, and embodied aspects of care. Our systematic review aimed to critically identify, appraise and synthesise the evidence on ethical dimensions of AI in nursing and midwifery to address these complex issues. We undertook a systematic review following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses checklist. We conducted a comprehensive search using key AI, ethics, nursing and midwifery terms across CINAHL, Embase, MEDLINE, The Philosopher's Index and PsycINFO in March 2025. We screened results on Covidence against eligibility criteria using independent reviewers and performed quality assessment. We extracted data and applied inductive thematic synthesis to identify key themes. Six themes emerged. First, preserving humanity emphasised care ethics in AI-mediated nursing and midwifery practice. Second, beyond technical reliability explored safety as an ethical and relational imperative examining premature deployment risks, misinformation as patient harm, and risk mitigation. Third, autonomy, authority and accountability focused on governance challenges and solutions including patient and professional autonomy. Fourth, beyond transparency examined privacy threats, trust-building, and the governance roles of nurses and midwives. Fifth, justice in development and deployment concentrated on algorithmic bias and equitable implementation. Sixth, workforce preparation and deployment centred on capacity gaps and training, critical thinking and ethical awareness, academic integrity, and implementation barriers. abstract: [Frontiers in public health] The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into healthcare is associated with new psychological challenges. However, the extent of its impact on nursing workforce stability is unclear. To explore the relationship between AI anxiety and turnover intention of clinical nurses, and the mediating effect of occupational fatigue and the moderating effect of emotional intelligence (EI). A cross-sectional survey was conducted from March to June 2026 among 404 clinical nurses from four hospitals in Jiangsu Province, China. Data were collected using the AI Anxiety Scale (AIAS), Health Workers' Occupational Fatigue Scale (HWOFS), Turnover Intention Scale (TIS) and Wong and Law Emotional Intelligence Scale (WLEIS). Mediation was tested using structural equation modelling with bootstrap resampling, while moderation was tested using moderated regression analysis. Differences in baseline turnover intentions across age, department, and professional title level were statistically significant (all p < 0.001). Path analysis showed that AI anxiety was positively associated with occupational fatigue (β = 0.611, p < 0.001) and turnover intention (β = 0.530, p < 0.001). Occupational fatigue partially mediated the association between AI anxiety and turnover intention (indirect effect = 0.299, 95% CI: 0.129, 0.379). EI had a significant negative main effect on occupational fatigue (b = -0.257, p < 0.001), but it did not significantly moderate the association between AI anxiety and occupational fatigue. AI anxiety is significantly correlated with the turnover intention of clinical nurses, and occupational fatigue may represent a potential pathway linking AI anxiety and turnover intention. Although EI is associated with lower levels of occupational fatigue, it fails to cushion the impact of AI anxiety, a specific stressor. Hospital administrators should focus on targeted AI literacy improvement plans and specific fatigue relief strategies to retain clinical nursing staff.
